resolution: Cleaned up the remaining wall-corner visual overlap. The prior fixes stopped endpoint tabs, but perpendicular rendered wall boxes still overlapped in plan by wall thickness, causing top-face hatching/crossing at corners. Changed the shared piece visual decomposition so rendered wall boxes make butt joints: collision bands still extend through joins, but visual bodies pull back by half wall thickness where needed so top faces do not overlap. Expanded wallSlabs tests with plan-rect no-overlap assertions for L-corners and T-junctions. Reran wallSlabs, placed, snap, and compile world parity suites.
